cards.title: from /frʌm/
sections: Bring the lower lip lightly to the upper teeth for /f/, then move into /r/. Keep the whole word to one syllable.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.

articulation.label: from
articulation.alt: from: /f/ → /r/ → /ʌ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
